purpose: Verify whether Clusterx can retrieve incrementally flushed SSP logs while a job is running.

submission.initial_error: SSP job names must be at most 32 runes.

observations.running_log_result: HTTP 404 from the SSP trainingJobs/{job}/pods endpoint
observations.completed_log_result: HTTP 404 from the SSP trainingJobs/{job}/pods endpoint

conclusion: The SSP job executed successfully and flushed progress from the workload, but Clusterx 2026.7.1 could not discover pods for this job. Consequently, clusterx log could retrieve neither running nor completed logs. A shared-storage result file remains a working fallback.
